Body: CloudFormation: AWS::ApiGateway::RestApi property holding the OpenAPI document
DefinitionBody: SAM: AWS::Serverless::Api property holding the OpenAPI document
RestApi: CloudFormation: API Gateway v1 resource, used as a synthetic id for an orphan route
HttpApi: SAM: API Gateway v2 event type, used as a synthetic id for an orphan route
Api: SAM: API Gateway v1 event type on a Serverless::Function
RestApiId: SAM: Api event property naming the REST API the route is on
ApiId: SAM: HttpApi event property naming the HTTP API the route is on
ServerlessRestApi: SAM: logical id of the REST API SAM creates for Api events that name none
ServerlessHttpApi: SAM: logical id of the HTTP API SAM creates for HttpApi events that name none
$default: API Gateway: catch-all route key on an HTTP API
AWS_PROXY: API Gateway: integration type, Lambda proxy
AWS: API Gateway: integration type, AWS service
HTTP_PROXY: API Gateway: integration type, HTTP proxy
MOCK: API Gateway: integration type answering without a backend
mock: API Gateway: integration type answering without a backend, lower cased
NONE: API Gateway: authorization type, no authorizer
iam: API Gateway: authorization type, IAM, lower cased
COGNITO_USER_POOLS: API Gateway: authorization type, Cognito user pool
cognito: API Gateway: authorization type, Cognito user pool, lower cased
CUSTOM: API Gateway: authorization type, Lambda authorizer
REQUEST: API Gateway: Lambda authorizer payload type
jwt: API Gateway: authorization type, JWT, lower cased
SQS: SAM: event source type on a Serverless::Function
SNS: SAM: event source type on a Serverless::Function
S3: SAM: event source type on a Serverless::Function
ENABLED: CloudFormation: AWS::Events::Rule State, the rule deploys switched on
DISABLED: CloudFormation: AWS::Events::Rule State, the rule deploys switched off
EventBridgeRule: SAM: event source type on a Serverless::Function
Schedule: SAM: event source type on a Serverless::Function
ScheduleV2: SAM: event source type on a Serverless::Function
schedule: suss: effect class for a scheduled invocation
codeUri: SAM: AWS::Serverless::Function property naming the code location
ref: CloudFormation: the Ref intrinsic, lower cased
template: suss: marker for a value the template states
globals: suss: marker for a value the SAM Globals section states
library: suss: marker for a value a library states
container: AWS deployment target, a container runtime
platform: suss: marker for a value the platform states
lambda: API Gateway integration kind and ALB TargetGroup TargetType, an AWS service integration onto Lambda
alb: ALB: TargetGroup TargetType naming another Application Load Balancer as the target, an NLB in front of an ALB
forward: ALB: listener rule / default action type, forwards to a target group
PathPatternConfig: ALB: listener rule condition property holding a path-pattern condition's Values
HostHeaderConfig: ALB: listener rule condition property holding a host-header condition's Values
HttpRequestMethodConfig: ALB: listener rule condition property holding an http-request-method condition's Values
HttpHeaderConfig: ALB: listener rule condition property holding an http-header condition's Values
QueryStringConfig: ALB: listener rule condition property holding a query-string condition's Key/Value pairs
SourceIpConfig: ALB: listener rule condition property holding a source-ip condition's Values
untyped: suss: marker for a resource with no CFN Type
routesTo: suss: flow-reachability edge kind, a listener rule or default action forwarding to a target
answers: suss: flow-reachability edge kind, a non-forward action's response
fronts: suss: flow-reachability edge kind, what backs a target group
belongsTo: suss: flow-reachability edge kind, which load balancer a listener belongs to
match: suss: MatchResult value, a condition or match this selector settles as admitting
nomatch: suss: MatchResult value, a condition or match this selector settles as refusing
A: Route 53: record type, an IPv4 address
AAAA: Route 53: record type, an IPv6 address
CNAME: Route 53: record type, another name to look up
dns: suss: match language for a hostname, so no ALB matcher evaluates one
GlobalSecondaryIndexes: CloudFormation: AWS::DynamoDB::Table property listing the indexes that key differently from the table
LocalSecondaryIndexes: CloudFormation: AWS::DynamoDB::Table property listing the indexes that share the table's partition key
RANGE: CloudFormation: AWS::DynamoDB::Table KeyType, the sort key
partial: suss: a storage contract that declares some of an item's fields
keyFields: suss: a storage contract identified by the fields a caller supplies
